experience.title: THE 23:30 MESSAGE
experience.premise: A man is found dead on a restricted luxury-hotel floor, yet a message in his own voice is delivered at 23:30 after he should already be dead.
experience.player_question: How could the victim send the 23:30 message if he was already dead, and who is using that contradiction to hide the true timeline?
dramatic_spine: The dead man apparently speaks at 23:30.
ALPHA appears suspicious because he controls the records.
ALPHA is exposed as having altered a record, creating a false solution.
ALPHA's secret explains the alteration but not the death.
GAMMA's illicit access creates another plausible but incomplete route.
The player realizes delivery time is not recording time.
BETA's knowledge contradicts his stated timeline.
The player must accuse the person positioned as the safest ally.
experience.truth: BETA caused the victim's death earlier in the evening and exploited a message the victim had scheduled in advance, using its 23:30 delivery to create a false later death window. ALPHA and GAMMA each conceal unrelated misconduct that creates fair misdirection.
experience.resolution: The player proves the 23:30 message was scheduled, disproves BETA's claimed last-seen timeline, and identifies BETA as the culprit.

role.label: Hotel security director
role.description: Controls the incident response and access records; conceals an unauthorized search.

role.label: Victim's private physician
role.description: The player's warmest apparent ally; actually the culprit, motivated by protecting another person.

role.label: Invited illusionist
role.description: Possesses unauthorized access for an unrelated objective and supplies entertaining suspicion.

relations.description: The actual death window makes BETA's claimed sighting impossible.
Scheduled delivery capability makes an earlier recording possible.
BETA's privileged knowledge undermines his claimed timeline.

opportunities.description: Determine whether the 23:30 message proves the victim was alive at 23:30.
Establish that the victim was already dead before the message was delivered.
Expose ALPHA's record manipulation and create the first false solution.
Expose GAMMA's illicit access without resolving the central timeline contradiction.

Choose who caused the victim's death.

completion_conditions.description: Resolve the false 23:30 time boundary and correctly accuse BETA through evidence rather than motive alone.
